title: 12 Best Night Markets in Almaty
description: Discover Almaty's vibrant night market scene! From traditional bazaars to modern food courts and bustling pedestrian streets, find the best late-night eats and unique experiences. Your guide to Almaty's evening culinary delights.

places.name: Arbat Street Eateries
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Doner Kebab from a popular kiosk or a scoop of artisanal ice cream.

places.name: Zelyony Bazaar (Green Bazaar) Food Stalls
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly baked Samsa (savory pastry) or a bowl of spicy Laghman noodles.

places.name: MEGA Alma-Ata Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Anything from sushi to burgers, or traditional Kazakh dishes from dedicated stalls.

places.name: Dostyk Plaza Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A gourmet burger from one of the specialty stalls or a freshly brewed coffee from a cafe.

places.name: Gogol Street Food Spots
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pirozhki (baked buns with various fillings) or spicy Korean-style salads.

places.name: Tulebaev & Kunaev Eateries
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Modern Kazakh cuisine like Beshbarmak with a contemporary twist or craft beer from a local pub.

places.name: Kok Tobe Park Dining
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Traditional Kazakh dishes served with a view, or a cocktail at a terrace bar.

places.name: Gorky Park Food Stalls
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Shashlik, cotton candy, or hot dogs from the mobile vendors.

places.name: Panfilov Park Street Food
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly brewed coffee or a warm baked good from a nearby bakery stall.

places.name: Esentai City Food Mall
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An artisanal burger with hand-cut fries or a customized fresh salad.

places.name: Forum Almaty Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pizza slices, various noodle dishes, or a classic fast-food combo from one of the many vendors.

places.name: Local Plov Centers
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Classic Uzbek Plov (meat and rice pilaf) served with a side of Achichuk (tomato and onion salad).
